notes.title: I Walk Among Zombies Vol. 0 Update
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/28625759f3791a83f1267106cbe9ec252b814b6b.png[/img]
Good afternoon! We have some more exciting news regarding the I Walk Among Zombies series! 

Both I Walk Among Zombies Vol. 3 and 0 will be releasing in December! The final date hasn't been announced yet, but we can tell you it'll be sooner rather than later! They have Steam pages up and are ready for your wishlist, so please do give them a click. We hope you're looking forward to the release. And if you haven't already, give the series a try on Steam! And please note: Vol. 3 and 0 are non adult versions, however Vol. 3 has a free 18+ DLC available through Steam to add back the content removed. 

Follow [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/39153917-I-Walk-Among-Zombies/]I Walk Among Zombies[/url] on Steam

notes.title: I Walk Among Zombies Vol. 2 Released!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/5997ad6da5144d7abcd6fd19f0627ad7087cc30f.png[/img]
Thanks for your patience, we're pleased to announce that I Walk Among Zombies Vol. 2 has now released on Steam! You can get the game uncensored and in English+Chinese language. To choose the language go to your steam library, right click "I Walk Among Zombies" or "末世孤雄" depending on your language preferences in Steam, click properties, then go to the language tab to pick the language you wish to download. Vol. 2 is currently 10% off until next Monday on Steam. Make sure to play Vol. 1 before starting Vol. 2!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/942850/I_Walk_Among_Zombies_Vol_1/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1100800/I_Walk_Among_Zombies_Vol_2/

[h1]That's all for now, follow our pages for the latest updates & news![/h1]
